resources.string: You already installed Family Help — well done. Leave it open.
Settings → Apps → Family Help → Battery → choose Unrestricted.\nThen Settings → Battery → Background usage limits → Never sleeping apps → add Family Help.
Settings → About phone → Software information → tap “Build number” 7 times, until it says developer mode is on.
In Developer options, turn Wireless debugging ON. Turn off “Automatically revoke” / auth timeout if the phone shows it.
Tap “Pair device with pairing code” — then STAY on that screen and read Tom the six numbers, and the small numbers next to “IP address and port”, and the pairing port. Do not type anything anywhere.
Keep the pairing screen open. If you leave it, the numbers change — tell Tom straight away.
Tap Get help, then follow the steps.
